note: server-check's bot speaks one protocol, the newest release in knowledge/mcprotocollib.json. A server on any other Minecraft version is joined through ViaProxy (github.com/ViaVersion/ViaProxy, GPL-3.0, run as its own process, never bundled), which translates between the bot's protocol and the server's. The jar is downloaded from the GitHub release and used only if its SHA-256 matches. Its own --list-versions output names the versions it can reach.
